info.title: B-Pharma LIMS machine integration API
info.description: For instruments, chromatography data systems and middleware. Authenticate with an API token issued by an Administrator (API clients screen); every record a client writes is attributed to its own service account in the audit trail. Writes are all-or-nothing batches of up to 500 items and need an Idempotency-Key. Errors are application/problem+json. Nothing in this API makes an electronic signature: review, approval and release stay with a person.

get.summary: List samples, newest first, one page at a time
get.description: Keyset paging: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null. Filters: `state`, `batch`.

state.description: Logged, Testing, Pending Review, Approved or Rejected

400.description: The request is not valid (problem details name each error)

429.description: Too many requests for this token (the rate limiter of the server; plain JSON, with a Retry-After header)

get.summary: Read a sample with its results
get.description: Each result carries its id, its limit as registered and its record `version`, which a results:batch item sends back as `expectedVersion`.

state.description: Logged, Testing, Pending Review, Approved or Rejected

limitKind.description: RANGE, NMT, NLT, TEXT or PRESENCE

lower.description: Lower limit as decimal text, as written in the specification

version.description: Send it back as expectedVersion when entering the value

400.description: The request is not valid (problem details name each error)

429.description: Too many requests for this token (the rate limiter of the server; plain JSON, with a Retry-After header)

post.summary: Register up to 500 samples in one call, all or nothing
post.description: Each sample is bound to the specification revision in force for its material and gets one result per parameter. If any item cannot be registered, nothing is and the problem names the item (`errors[].index`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per logical request. A repeat with the same key and body gets the stored answer and writes nothing; the same key with another body is 422.

201.description: The registered samples, in the order of the items

Idempotent-Replayed.description: "true" when this is the stored answer of an earlier call with the same key

state.description: Logged, Testing, Pending Review, Approved or Rejected

400.description: The request is not valid (problem details name each error)

409.description: Conflict with the current state or version of a record

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused for a different request

429.description: Too many requests for this token (the rate limiter of the server; plain JSON, with a Retry-After header)

post.summary: Enter up to 500 result values in one call, all or nothing
post.description: The same rules as entry at the bench apply to every item. A result that already has a value is not changed by a machine (409 RESULT_ALREADY_ENTERED): a correction is made by a person, with a reason. If any item is refused, nothing is written and the problem names the item (`errors[].index`). One audit entry per result, attributed to the client's service account.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per logical request. A repeat with the same key and body gets the stored answer and writes nothing; the same key with another body is 422.

expectedVersion.description: The result version read from GET /samples/{sampleId}

instrumentId.description: The instrument the value was measured on; defaults to the instrument the client is bound to

reason.description: Recorded in the audit entry, followed by the client name and the Idempotency-Key

200.description: The saved results, in the order of the items

Idempotent-Replayed.description: "true" when this is the stored answer of an earlier call with the same key

oosInvestigationId.description: The investigation an OOS value opened (or the open one it belongs to)

get.summary: The specification in force today, for one material or for all

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material name; case and spacing do not matter. Without it, every material with a specification in force.

200.description: The revisions in force (empty when none is)

400.description: The request is not valid (problem details name each error)

429.description: Too many requests for this token (the rate limiter of the server; plain JSON, with a Retry-After header)

get.summary: The disposition of a batch: released, rejected or on hold, and what blocks its release
get.description: `releasable` is true when the batch is on hold and nothing blocks its release. The release itself is an e-signature by a person.

status.description: Quarantine Hold (no release record yet), Released or Rejected

400.description: The request is not valid (problem details name each error)

apiToken.description: An API token. The scope an operation needs is listed in its security requirement. Scopes: samples:read (List samples and read a sample with its results (ids, limits and record versions).); samples:write (Register samples against the specification in force (up to 500 in one call).); results:write (Enter result values on samples in Testing (up to 500 in one call), under the same rules as entry at the bench.); specifications:read (Read the specification in force for a material.); batches:read (Read the disposition of a batch: released or on hold, and what blocks its release.)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is a stable machine code (see x-problem-codes); `errors` names each refused field or batch item.

type.description: Link to the entry of `code` on the local docs page

pointer.description: JSON pointer into the request, e.g. /items/3/value

index.description: The refused item of a batch

x-problem-codes.description: The bearer token is not an API token of this system.
The API token has passed its expiry date.
The service account of the client was deactivated.
The token does not hold the scope the operation needs.
The request does not match the schema (unknown keys are refused).
The body is not valid JSON.
A write needs an Idempotency-Key header.
The Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request.
An item of a batch was refused; nothing of the batch was written.
The result already has a value; a correction is made by a person.
The record was changed since it was read (expectedVersion).
The route exists but not with this method.
The body is larger than the API accepts (2 MB).
Unexpected error; quote the requestId to the administrator.
